title: What Is Pontinha in Funchal, and Why Is It Famous?
description: Pontinha is the rocky point at the west end of Funchal bay, tied to an islet by an 1890 breakwater: two forts, a cruise pier and a self-declared principality.
heroAlt: The small Forte de São José on its rock beside the Pontinha breakwater, seen from the sea

images.prompt: Late afternoon at the Pontinha, Funchal, Madeira, photographed from the water about 150 metres offshore at low angle. In the foreground, calm green-blue sea. Ahead, a small old stone fort with simple walls sits on a dark volcanic rock right beside the long harbour breakwater. Warm low sun from the west lights the stone. On the right edge, part of the white hull of a moored cruise ship. No people in close-up, true colours, realistic photo, no text.
images.alt: The small Forte de São José on its rock beside the Pontinha breakwater, seen from the sea
